category.reason: The task requires comparing the straight-line distances from a fixed station marker to the visible café markers on the map.

instruction.en: On the map, find the café marker closest to the blue “Gare de Lyon” center marker by straight-line distance.
instruction.zh: 在图中找到与 “Gare de Lyon” 蓝色中心标记直线距离最近的咖啡店标记。
